title: check that recall-toy, cutoffs-toy and long-seqs-toy find real hits end to end
body: A toy is for build, run, parse, plot with real hits at every stage. A toy that runs clean and finds nothing leaves everything after the search untested, which is how loss-decomp parse shipped broken. cloud-search-toy and loss-decomp-toy were raised to 400 families against 50,000 sequences a side and produce tens of thousands of rows; pid-toy runs end to end with real hits. recall-toy, cutoffs-toy and long-seqs-toy have not been checked; recall's toy finds nothing that clears a cutoff, so its summary writer has never run. Scale the toy, never add a fixture beside it.
close_reason: Commit dcdd68d: every toy finds real hits end to end, and long-seqs' toy label is removed as meaningless at six pairs.

notes.author: jackroddy/21204bf1
notes.text: cutoffs-toy done 6 Oct: recipe raised to 1000 families over 2 shards of 50,000, builds in 18 s, every stage finds something (13 rejects, 2,084 decoys, cutoffs for 235 nail / 672 mmseqs / 263 hmmer families), all five stages in about a minute at -t 48 -j 48. recall-toy and long-seqs-toy still unchecked.

notes.author: jackroddy/0d39a02d
notes.text: recall-toy scaled to fams 1000, seqs 50000, shards 2 (commit after d3f18ab): summary rows for all 6 runs, hmmer 6,299 hits over cutoff, nail 5,286-5,634, mmseqs 4,479-4,924. long-seqs has no toy any more: six pairs, nail only, real label runs end to end in 26 s.
